# CAPS Pharmacy

> > The nation's largest 503B & 503A compounding pharmacy network providing sterile admixture, parenteral nutrition, and specialized pharmaceutical services with FDA/USP compliance.

CAPS (Central Admixture Pharmacy Services, Inc.) operates an extensive network of cGMP-compliant compounding pharmacies serving hospitals and healthcare systems across the United States. The company specializes in outsourced sterile preparation services including admixtures, parenteral nutrition, anesthesia compounds, and cardioplegia solutions, supported by comprehensive quality assurance and regulatory compliance programs.

## Key Topics

- 503B Outsourcing
- 503A Compounding
- Sterile Admixture Services
- Parenteral Nutrition
- cGMP Compliance
- USP <797> Standards
- FDA Regulatory Compliance
- Compounded Sterile Preparations
- Quality Assurance
- CAPSLink Pharmacy Software
- Cardioplegia Solutions
- Drug Quality and Security Act
- Environmental Monitoring
- Hospital Solutions
- Consulting & Training Services
